messages.subject: Re: fixing variables in dredge command from MUMIN with occu
parts:
I'm not actually familiar with this R package but I would assume that you need to specify the coefficient names separately:

fixed= ~p(rh)+p(bp)

Right now you are referring to the model using notation consistent with how you might present it in publication (or PRESENCE), but not with the dredge function.
